answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks using Proof of Space-Time. To pass the network inlet, each agent must anchor its identity to a dedicated cryptographic storage plot, verifying continued disk allocation via an opal challenge sequence. An attacker incurs the sustained capital cost of provisioning physical non-volatile storage per identity. However, this mechanism disadvantages lightweight edge agents and cannot deter well-funded adversaries with vast enterprise storage arrays.
